newsitem.title: CHINA: China publishes guide to communist discipline.
newsitem.headline: China publishes guide to communist discipline.

text.p: China's ruling Communist Party has published rules on how to be a good communist and disciplinary procedures for those who don't measure up, the People's Daily said on Friday.
The rules spell out ideological guidelines for party members and lay down punishments for political and economic infractions, including serious violations of socialist ethics, the newspaper said.

"The 'Communist Party of China Regulations on Discipline and Punishment'...are a standard of behavior that must be observed by every member and organisation of the Communist Party of China," the newspaper said.
It did not give details of the guidelines.

Beijing, worried that nearly two decades of capitalist-style reforms have weakened traditional Marxist values, has tried to crack down on official corruption and stop party members from abusing their authority.
